race.description: Port Lincoln Cup Carnival 24-26 Feb Hcp (56)
race.comment: OUTCASTER (12) has the most persuasive recent form, having been beaten a head by Utah at this track after travelling well, and that followed a third to Gusmao when beaten just under a length. She has placed three times from three starts at this track and distance and the 1.5kg claim helps her convert consistency into a win. FORTIS IN ARMIS (8) improved sharply last start when sixth, beaten two and a half lengths by Utah after being slow to begin, and his three wins and five placings around 1350m give him a genuine platform third-up. CHESTERAY (1) comes back from BM60 and BM64 form, has won at this track and is well proven around 1350m, so he can rebound from two plain 1210m runs. IT'S A SOLID DEEL (2) can keep the ball rolling after a solid win last start.
